name: illumio-branded-reports
description: Generate professional branded PDF and HTML reports using Illumio's visual identity. WeasyPrint-based PDF generation with running headers, architecture diagrams, code blocks, and phase banners. Includes programmatic visual verification (SVG overflow, z-index, DOM overflow, image load), PII guardrails for customer/partner/leadership-facing deliverables, and bilingual EN/ES support.
